segments.en: investors approached about potentially buying shares in Aura, now delayed IPO decided not to go forward because of concerns including the health and fitness ring maker companies target valuation.

segments.en: Bloomberg's Anthony Hughes joins us now on this. So what exactly was the pushback Anthony?

segments.en: because of that but in Aura's case they had a bit of a complicated comp set in terms of you know, made it more challenge for people to work out the right valuation and I think there was
segments.zh: 但在Oura的案例中，他们的可比公司组合有些复杂，这让人们更难确定合适的估值，我认为还有

segments.zh: 关于锁定期也有一些阻力，此外还有竞争问题，即一些大玩家是否会介入并抢走他们的午餐，或者在产品方面
